arguments.message:
Hi! If you’ve lost access to your old authenticator after switching phones, you can re‑enrol without losing access by following these steps:

1. Use one of your saved recovery codes to log in. If you can’t reach the Settings page without a working code, the recovery code will let you sign in and get to the 2‑FA section.
2. In Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication, tap **Reset**.
3. Scan the new QR code that appears and confirm with the fresh six‑digit code generated by your authenticator app.
4. Save the new recovery codes that are shown after enrolment.

Once you reset, the old QR code is invalidated, so only the newly scanned code will work from now on. If you don’t have a recovery code, please let us know and we’ll help you recover access.
